svg.aria-label: Security controls in five rings around the data and services, from the outside in. Anything from outside has to pass every ring to reach the center. Physical: Four cameras watch the house and record to a recorder in the rack. Controls: Surveillance (PoE cameras · NVR). Perimeter: Stops and inspects anything coming from the internet. Controls: Firewall and IDS, No open doors (OPNsense firewall · Suricata IDS · no port forwards). Network: Keeps each kind of device on its own separate network. Controls: Separate VLANs, Guest Wi-Fi, Cameras, Storage (6 VLANs · Guest-Internet, IP-Cameras and NAS access lists). Access: Decides who can sign in and who can change settings. Controls: Admin-only logins, Central accounts (Admin-SSH access list · Active Directory · CA · NPS). Data protection: Keeps systems updated, watched, backed up and private. Controls: Updates, Monitoring, Backups, Safe to share (WSUS · Wazuh · Splunk · LibreNMS · UNAS Pro).
svg.title: Security controls
